name: Battlezone
detail: This is the Auxiliary PCB 035678-01; Battlezone's game PCB is 035742. They are different boards with separate designator grids, connected by J19 -- the game PCB sends EDB0-7, EAB0-6, ER/WB, EI/O, EPHI2 and the E6MHZ/E12KHZ/E3MHZ clocks across. A designator like C1 means a different chip on each.

name: Red Baron
detail: Red Baron uses this same Auxiliary PCB, so every device position and signature here applies to both games and a known-good board from either checks the other.
